name: PdxDataGrid
description:
A data grid with sorting, pagination and type-aware cell rendering, whose cells and headers can be
replaced with slot templates.

members.name: source
members.description: The data source to render from.

members.name: columns
members.description: Column definitions: field, header, width, sortable, render, etc.

members.name: data
members.description: The row data to display.

members.name: striped
members.description: Alternates row background colours.

members.name: hover
members.description: Highlights the row under the pointer.

members.name: rowClickable
members.description:
The rows open something: a click on a row is handled (`pdx-row-click`), so the row takes
a pointer, so a page does not write its own `.pdx-dg-row { cursor: pointer }`, reaching into
this component's internal class. Enter on a row is unchanged: it edits a cell in an
editable grid and does nothing otherwise, so give a keyboard reader a way in of its own
(an `actions()` column).

members.name: compact
members.description: Tighter row height for dense tables.

members.name: stickyHeader
members.description: Keeps the header visible while the body scrolls.

members.name: selection
members.description: Row selection mode: 'none', 'single' or 'multiple'.

members.name: rowClass
members.description:
A class for the whole row: a string, or `(row, index) => string`. Marks a row invalid,
new, stale — what `cellClass` could only do one column at a time.

Declared `String` because an ATTRIBUTE is one (`row-class="compact"`), and `PropType` is
a single constructor. A function assigned as a JS property arrives untouched: `coerce`
returns a non-string value as it is (`component.ts:448`).

members.name: idField
members.description: The row field used as a unique key.

members.name: stateKey
members.description: Persists sort/filter/column state under this key.

members.name: emptyTitle
members.description: The empty state's text. Unset, it is the grid string `empty.title`.

members.name: emptyIcon
members.description: Icon shown in the empty state.

members.name: showFooter
members.description: Shows the footer (aggregates / summary row).

members.name: filterable
members.description: Enables per-column filtering.

members.name: filterMode
members.description: How filters apply: e.g. 'menu' or 'row'.

members.name: showToolbar
members.description: Shows the toolbar (search, column chooser, export).

members.name: search
members.description: A search field at the toolbar's right: the term is looked for in the columns marked `searchable`.

members.name: showGroupBar
members.description: Shows the drag-to-group bar.

members.name: paginationPosition
members.description: Where the pager sits: 'top', 'bottom' or 'both'.

members.name: pageSizes
members.description: The rows-per-page choices the footer's pager offers; empty, it offers none.

members.name: expandable
members.description: Allows rows to expand into a detail panel.

members.name: groupBy
members.description: Fields to group rows by.

members.name: virtualScroll
members.description: Renders only visible rows for large datasets.

members.name: rowHeight
members.description: Row height in px for virtual scrolling (42 when unset); ignored otherwise.

members.name: maxHeight
members.description: Caps the grid height in px; the body scrolls beyond it. 0 = no cap (a virtual grid uses 400).

members.name: fillHeight
members.description:
Fill the parent's height (flex) instead of growing with content. The page no longer
scrolls — only the grid body scrolls (virtualized). Pair with virtual-scroll for large sets.

members.name: editable
members.description: Enables inline cell editing.

members.name: editMode
members.description: Editing granularity: 'cell' or 'row'.

members.name: label
members.description: The grid's accessible name (its aria-label).

members.name: grid
members.description: Read-only, via a ref: `el.grid`.

members.name: whenReady
members.description:
Resolves once the grid is built and `grid`, `applyState` and the rest can be used.
The build is a frame after the element connects; until then `applyState` does nothing.
A caller that asks later is answered at once.

members.name: openColumnMenu
members.description: Open the column menu anchored to this element.

members.name: closeColumnMenu
members.description: Close the column menu, if one is open.

members.name: openFilterPopover
members.description: Open the filter popover of a column, by field, anchored to this element. An unknown field opens nothing.

members.name: closeFilterPopover
members.description: Close the filter popover, if one is open.

members.name: openAddFilter
members.description: Open the add-a-filter popover anchored to this element.

members.name: clearAllFilters
members.description: Drop every filter: the ones set in the popovers and the ones on the source.

members.name: toggleRowDetail
members.description: Open or close the detail row under this row id.

members.name: startEdit
members.description: Begin an edit: one cell when a field is given, otherwise the whole row — in a dialog or inline, as `edit-mode` says.

members.name: cancelEdit
members.description: Abandon the edit in progress and discard what was typed.

members.name: addRow
members.description: Append an empty row, with a negative id until it is saved, and start editing it in dialog and row modes.

members.name: deleteRow
members.description: Delete a row by id and emit `pdx-row-delete`. It asks nothing first, and in batch mode does not sync.

members.name: clearSelection
members.description: Uncheck every selected row.

members.name: getSelectedIds
members.description: The ids currently checked, as an array.

members.name: setSelectedIds
members.description: Check exactly these rows and uncheck the rest — what a partly refused bulk action leaves behind.

members.name: applyState
members.description:
Put an arrangement back — filter, sort, column order, widths, visibility, page size
— and show it.

`grid.loadState()` is the same thing without the repaint: an application that
reaches for it gets a grid whose model has moved and whose header has not. It raises
no column event either, and that is deliberate: restoring a saved view is not a
reader rearranging anything.

members.name: commitBatch
members.description: Send every change a batch edit is holding, then sync the source.

members.name: revertBatch
members.description: Throw away every change a batch edit is holding.

events.name: pdx-row-click
events.description: Fired when the row is clicked.
events.detail: { row: T; index: number; id: unknown }

events.name: pdx-row-reorder
events.detail: { from: number; to: number; fromId: unknown; toId: unknown }

events.name: pdx-cell-edit-start
events.detail: { rowId: unknown; field: string; value: unknown }

events.name: pdx-cell-edit-end
events.detail: { rowId: unknown; field: string; oldValue: unknown; newValue: unknown }

events.name: pdx-grid-export
events.detail: { rows: number; columns: number; format: string }

events.name: pdx-column-visibility-change
events.description: Fired when the column visibility changes.
events.detail: { field: string; visible: boolean; columnVisibility: Record<string, boolean> }

events.name: pdx-column-resize
events.detail: { field: string; width: number; columnWidths: Record<string, number> }

slots.name: cell
slots.description: Draws a cell, one snippet for every column: `cell(row, column, value)`, switching on `column.field`. A column it draws nothing for (no element, no text) is drawn by the grid, so a page writes only the columns it changes.
slots.signature: (row: T, column: { field: string; header?: string; type?: string; command?: boolean; [key: string]: unknown }, value: unknown)

slots.name: header
slots.description: Draws a column's header: `header(column)`; a column it draws nothing for keeps its title.
slots.signature: (column: { field: string; header?: string; type?: string; command?: boolean; [key: string]: unknown })

slots.name: editCell
slots.description: Draws the editor of the cell being edited: `editCell(row, column, value, form)`, switching on `column.field`; a column it draws nothing for gets the grid's editor. Enter, Tab and a click outside commit the value of its first control. `form` is null in a cell edit.
slots.signature: (row: T, column: { field: string; header?: string; type?: string; command?: boolean; [key: string]: unknown }, value: unknown, form: import('@pdxui/core').Form<Record<string, unknown>> | null)

slots.name: filter
slots.description: Draws a column's cell in the filter row: `filter(column)`; a column it draws nothing for keeps the grid's input.
slots.signature: (column: { field: string; header?: string; type?: string; command?: boolean; [key: string]: unknown })

slots.name: filterPopover
slots.description: Draws a column's filter popover: `filterPopover(column, apply, clear)`. `apply()` applies the grid's filters and closes it, `clear()` drops this column's filter and closes it. A column it draws nothing for gets the grid's popover.
slots.signature: (column: { field: string; header?: string; type?: string; command?: boolean; [key: string]: unknown }, apply: () => void, clear: () => void)

slots.name: toolbarStart
slots.description: Draws at the start of the toolbar, after Reload: `toolbarStart(grid)`.

slots.name: toolbarEnd
slots.description: Draws at the end of the toolbar, after the spacer: `toolbarEnd(grid)`.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Draws the empty state in place of the grid's icon and title: `empty()`.

cssParts.name: grid
cssParts.description: The scroll area that is the `role="grid"`: header, filter row, body, summary.

cssParts.name: summary
cssParts.description: The summary row, when a column declares an aggregate.

cssParts.name: footer
cssParts.description: The footer and its pager; above the grid too with `pagination-position`.

cssParts.name: empty
cssParts.description: The empty status, while the source has settled with no row.

cssParts.name: loading
cssParts.description: The loading overlay, while the source is pending.

cssStates.name: hover
cssStates.description: `hover`: a row under the pointer is highlighted.

cssStates.name: row-clickable
cssStates.description: `row-clickable`: the rows open something, and take a pointer.

cssStates.name: sticky-header
cssStates.description: `sticky-header`: the header stays while the body scrolls.

cssStates.name: fill-height
cssStates.description: `fill-height`: the grid fills its parent's height and only its body scrolls.

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: The source is pending; the grid is `aria-busy` meanwhile.

cssStates.name: empty
cssStates.description: The source has settled with no row; the empty status says so.

cssStates.name: editing
cssStates.description: A cell or a row is being edited.

capabilities.name: sortable
capabilities.description: A column declared `sortable` sorts on its header; the header carries `aria-sort`.

capabilities.name: filterable
capabilities.description: The rows filter, with `filterable`: by column, in a row, a popover or the toolbar (`filter-mode`).

capabilities.name: selectable
capabilities.description: Rows are checked, one or many, with `selection="single"` or `"multiple"`.

capabilities.name: editable
capabilities.description: Cells or rows are edited in place or in a dialog, with `editable` and `edit-mode`.
